decisions.reason: The click-in adapter is an accessory to the firm's established track system and was featured on the home page, so it likely meets aspirations, and in a growing industry the firm has the slack to keep a low-cost complementary item.

The LED luminaire sits close to the core range and the industry is growing, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger search, though single luminaires in fast-moving LED ranges are often replaced after a few years.

The home automation server box underpins the firm's smart-home control offer and its strategic positioning, so management will likely carry it with available slack despite uncertain results and fast-moving technology.
The luminaire family received a page of its own, which signals it is a meaningful part of the range that likely satisfies aspirations, so there is little reason to drop it soon.
